## Hypothesis

We want to measure the current engine's performance on the J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) using real-fills simulation, and then run a walk-forward OOS test on 2025-Q3/2026-Q1 to obtain verified edge_capture and Sharpe.

## Mechanism

We will run a backtest using the real-fills simulator (REAL_OPRA_SIM) on the top 3 J anchor days to get the P&L for each day, then compute edge_capture as defined in OP-16. Then we will run a walk-forward OOS test on 2025-Q3/2026-Q1 (training on earlier data, testing on 2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1) to get the OOS Sharpe.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** We will use the top 3 J anchor days for real-fills replay (n=3 days) and walk-forward OOS on 2025-Q3/2026-Q1 (n=~8 months). Overfit risk is high due to small anchor sample; we will report concentration and quarterly breakdown.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window: 2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J anchor days)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: max loss on any J anchor day; max drawdown in OOS window; blow-up scenario if edge_capture < 771.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L in OOS window, state X (to be measured).

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
